fieldValues.title: Add an Analyst (scout) to WG Third-party ready to keep its queue fed
fieldValues.decision_question: How is the WG Third-party ready queue kept fed with ruling-backed work?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's working session on 2026-10-10 (Claude Code conversation); awaiting the owner's ratification. The group's first report forecast the queue running dry: 8 ready issues against a budget of 10 per cycle. Feeding the queue is the Analyst stance (finds the core issue), the blind spot the concept doc predicted for this group.
fieldValues.friction: Without a feeder the builder runs out of work within a cycle and someone has to seed the queue by hand.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: Trigger: on running dry (chosen) or on a daily clock. Feeder: a scout member (chosen) or the owner seeding by hand. Sources: conformance gaps and unimplemented rulings (chosen first); parked issues citing a ruling and the 2026-10-08 audit drift list (not yet).
fieldValues.decision_statement: Add a fourth member, an Analyst (scout), whose standing job is keeping the queue fed. It acts when the steward's report forecasts the queue running dry (checked daily at 12:00 UTC), files only ruling-backed work within the group's mandate (capped at about two cycles), and turns anything needing a new ruling into a minute of exercise or an escalation. Its first sources are conformance gaps (srs conformance fixtures and invariants against srs-rust) and ratified rulings with no implementation.
fieldValues.rationale: The queue must be fed for the group to work, and feeding it is a distinct stance from building or reviewing. Triggering on running dry keeps it from flooding the owner.
fieldValues.revisit_when: After the scout's first three runs: did it keep the queue fed without flooding, and were its issues within the mandate? Revisit the sources when the first two run dry.
fieldValues.next_steps: Agent and standing-job records plus routines/wg-analyst.md (srs-programme); routine wg-third-party-ready-analyst created after review. Membership and quorum standing order updated after ratification.
